title: Full-service property care, start to finish
intro: From weekly mowing to the first snowfall, ScapeLift keeps your property sharp so you don't have to think about it.

items.title: Mowing & Trimming
items.description: Clean, consistent weekly cuts and crisp edges that keep the whole property looking cared for.

items.title: Mulch & Bed Care
items.description: Fresh mulch, tidy beds, and healthy plantings that make the front of the house pop.

items.title: Trees & Shrubs
items.description: Shaping, trimming, and seasonal pruning to keep everything healthy and in proportion.

items.title: Weed Control
items.description: Targeted, natural-first weed management along beds, walkways, and hardscape.

items.title: Shoreline Care
items.description: Lakefront cleanup and maintenance that respects the water and keeps your frontage beautiful.

items.title: Garage Clean-Ups
items.description: Haul-outs, organizing, and reset days that hand you back a garage you can actually use.

items.title: Snow Removal

items.title: Seasonal Clean-Ups
